{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check how many rows have -999.0 in biomarker_baseline or biomarker_final
mask_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0
mask_final = df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0

print(f'Rows with -999.0 in biomarker_baseline: {mask_baseline.sum()}')
print(f'Rows with -999.0 in biomarker_final: {mask_final.sum()}')
print(f'Rows with -999.0 in either: {mask_baseline | mask_final}.sum()')

# Drop rows where either baseline or final biomarker is -999.0
df_clean = df[~(mask_baseline | mask_final)].copy()

# Verify that -999.0 is no longer present
print(f'After cleaning, biomarker_baseline has -999.0: {df_clean["biomarker_baseline"].isin([-999.0]).any()}')
print(f'After cleaning, biomarker_final has -999.0: {df_clean["biomarker_final"].isin([-999.0]).any()}')

# Check sex distribution after cleaning
df_clean['sex'].value_counts()"}
